rules.description: Applicant must be under State Pension age
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be under State Pension age to claim New Style ESA

rules.description: Applicant must have a disability or health condition that affects ability to work
rules.reason_if_failed: New Style ESA is for people whose health condition prevents or limits their ability to work

rules.description: Applicant must have a fit note if unable to work for more than 7 days
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a fit note from your doctor if you've been unable to work for more than 7 days

rules.description: Applicant must have paid enough National Insurance contributions in the last 2-3 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to have paid enough National Insurance contributions in the last 2 to 3 years. National Insurance credits also count. Check your NI record for gaps.

rules.description: Applicant must not be claiming Jobseeker's Allowance
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get New Style ESA if you claim Jobseeker's Allowance (JSA)

rules.description: Applicant must not be receiving Statutory Sick Pay
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot get New Style ESA if you're getting Statutory Sick Pay (SSP). You can apply up to 3 months before your SSP ends.

rules.description: If working, applicant must work less than 16 hours per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim ESA if you work 16 or more hours per week

rules.description: If working, applicant must not earn more than £195.50 per week
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot claim ESA if you earn more than £195.50 per week

explanation_template: New Style ESA eligibility: {outcome}. You will undergo a Work Capability Assessment to determine your support needs.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is nearing the end of life (medical professional confirms 12 months or less to live)
edge_cases.action: Fast-track to support group. Higher payment rate immediately. No Work Capability Assessment or Claimant Commitment required. Form SR1 from medical professional triggers this pathway.

edge_cases.description: Applicant's Statutory Sick Pay is due to end within 3 months
edge_cases.action: Allow application now. ESA payments will start when SSP ends. Applicant should provide SSP end date.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is also claiming Universal Credit
edge_cases.action: Eligible for both. UC payment will be reduced by New Style ESA amount. Only one Work Capability Assessment needed. New Style ESA provides Class 1 NI credits.

edge_cases.description: Applicant receives private pension income over £85 per week
edge_cases.action: ESA payment reduced by half of pension income over £85. Example: £100 pension = £7.50 deduction. May still receive NI credits even if no payment.

edge_cases.description: Illness or disability severely limits what applicant can do
edge_cases.action: Place in support group (higher rate, no work-related activity requirements). Assessment determines this.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is in hospital, care home or sheltered accommodation
edge_cases.action: May not need Work Capability Assessment. Report this circumstance immediately as it affects claim.
Report immediately. May affect claim assessment and group placement.

edge_cases.description: Applicant starts or stops caring for someone
edge_cases.action: Report immediately. May be eligible for Carer's Allowance instead or in addition. Affects ESA assessment.
